status: Closed — source, focused regressions, and frozen runner evidence re-verified on 2026-09-05
finding: batch checkpoint can partially mutate and close the queue-head task before failing on the next queued task's owner mismatch. This violates the playbook expectation that checkpoint is the safe boundary before commit.
expectedBehavior: batch checkpoint should be atomic per queue head: either finish the current queue-head checkpoint and return a committable bundle, or fail before mutating close state. It should not close the queue head and then fail because the next queued task is blocked/owned by another actor.
evidenceOrRepro: On 2026-07-19, after runner-sync build/release for ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-plan-series-skill, `node atm.mjs batch checkpoint --actor codex-governance-optimizer --json` failed with ATM_TASK_CLOSE_OWNER_MISMATCH for TASK-SYNC-0001 owned by codex-atm-gov-0156. Immediately afterward, `node atm.mjs tasks status --task ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-plan-series-skill --json` showed the queue head live ledger as done/released with close and lock-cleanup events, leaving closure packet, runner-sync receipt, release artifacts, and task events staged/dirty even though checkpoint returned failure.
followUp: Immediate ghost-task cause was fixed in packages/cli/src/commands/task-direction.ts by filtering terminal ledger tasks when creating queues, skipping terminal ledger tasks when advancing legacy queues, and completing terminal-only queues. Batch runtime also normalizes terminal-only active batches in packages/cli/src/commands/work-channels.ts. Imported task discovery excludes terminal ledger tasks in packages/cli/src/commands/next/route-resolution/queue-inspection.ts, so explicitly mentioning TASK-SYNC-0001 no longer resurrects the superseded task. The remaining checkpoint issue was fixed by f3b7692ea: packages/cli/src/commands/batch/checkpoint-commit-window-policy.ts requires a durable commit window after closing the current queue head, and checkpoint wiring does not call runNext before that commit. The source and frozen dist seams are aligned, and checkpoint-commit-window-policy.test.ts plus batch-checkpoint-runner-sync-recovery.test.ts exited 0 on 2026-09-05. No open repair or publication follow-up remains for this item.
